subject: quick note about brooklynfamilydentalcare.com
body:
Hi Terry,

Ran an accessibility scan on brooklynfamilydentalcare.com this morning and found 30 elements that put the site at ADA Title III risk — the same category of issues driving 5,000+ small-business lawsuits in 2025 (69% against companies under $25M).

Three most urgent on your site:

1. 2 UI elements with color contrast below 4.5:1 (WCAG minimum). This is the #1 trigger for ADA drive-by lawsuits against small practices.

3. 5 links with no discernible text — screen readers announce them as 'link' with no destination. Booking and contact flows are especially exposed.

I can send you the full 17-point audit (with remediation code your webmaster can copy-paste) — free, no strings. If you want me to fix it, flat $1,200, done in 2 weeks.
